calls.thesis: Buying opportunity, MEDIUM conviction. Down ~50% in a year on SKU cuts, Rockstar/Alani indigestion, macro headwinds. Forward PE 16.4 — premium to PepsiCo gone (PEP 14x, KO 25x). Revenue $300M (2022) → $3B+; cash-flow positive, double-digit CFO/sales. DCF fair value >$43 vs ~$28 (>52% upside 12-18mo) even after lowering cash-flow estimates and raising risk. Bear: ROIC volatile since acquisitions; margin expansion slower than hoped.
calls.base_case: Fair value >$43, >52% upside 12-18 months, beating S&P 500.
calls.bull_case: Core brand recovers, international expansion + Alani scale margins back to low-50% gross.
calls.bear_case: Acquisition indigestion persists; energy-drink growth stalls; ROIC keeps deteriorating.
